--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.PrimeFin
/-- A version of `Nat.exists_infinite_primes` using the `Set.Infinite` predicate. -/
theorem infinite_setOf_prime : { p | Prime p }.Infinite :=
  Set.infinite_of_not_bddAbove not_bddAbove_setOf_prime

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Cardinal.Finite
theorem natCard_pos (hs : s.Finite) : 0 < Nat.card s ↔ s.Nonempty := by
  simp [pos_iff_ne_zero, Nat.card_eq_zero, hs.to_subtype, nonempty_iff_ne_empty]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Basic
lemma exists_card_eq [Infinite α] : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ s : Finset α, s.card = n
  | 0 => ⟨∅, card_empty⟩
  | n + 1 => by
    classical
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := exists_card_eq n
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := s.exists_not_mem
    exact ⟨insert a s, card_insert_of_not_mem ha⟩

--src: Mathlib.Data.Set.Card
theorem finite_of_encard_eq_coe {k : ℕ} (h : s.encard = k) : s.Finite :=
  finite_of_encard_le_coe h.le

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Game.Birthday
@[simp]
theorem birthday_one : birthday 1 = 1 := by rw [birthday_def]; simp

--src: Mathlib.Data.Finite.Defs
/-- Constructor for `Set.Finite` using a `Finite` instance. -/
theorem toFinite (s : Set α) [Finite s] : s.Finite := ‹_›

--src: Mathlib.Data.Set.Card
theorem ncard_eq_toFinset_card (s : Set α) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    s.ncard = hs.toFinset.card := by
  rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq, @Nat.card_eq_fintype_card _ hs.fintype,
    @Finite.card_toFinset _ _ hs.fintype hs]

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Cardinal.Finite
lemma card_ne_zero : Nat.card α ≠ 0 ↔ Nonempty α ∧ Finite α := by simp [card_eq_zero, not_or]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Totient
/-- A characterisation of `Nat.totient` that avoids `Finset`. -/
theorem totient_eq_card_lt_and_coprime (n : ℕ) : φ n = Nat.card { m | m < n ∧ n.Coprime m } := by
  let e : { m | m < n ∧ n.Coprime m } ≃ {x ∈ range n | n.Coprime x} :=
    { toFun := fun m => ⟨m, by simpa only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] using m.property⟩
      invFun := fun m => ⟨m, by simpa only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] using m.property⟩
      left_inv := fun m => by simp only [Subtype.coe_mk, Subtype.coe_eta]
      right_inv := fun m => by simp only [Subtype.coe_mk, Subtype.coe_eta] }
  rw [totient_eq_card_coprime, card_congr e, card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_coe]

C1_dependencies.name: Nat.card
C1_dependencies.content:
/-- `Nat.card α` is the cardinality of `α` as a natural number.
  If `α` is infinite, `Nat.card α = 0`. -/
protected def card (α : Type*) : ℕ :=
  toNat (mk α)

C1_dependencies.name: Set
C1_dependencies.content:
/-- A set is a collection of elements of some type `α`.

Although `Set` is defined as `α → Prop`, this is an implementation detail which should not be
relied on. Instead, `setOf` and membership of a set (`∈`) should be used to convert between sets
and predicates.
-/
def Set (α : Type u) := α → Prop
